effectiveRuleSubtitle: Effective after 3 months continuous cover · subject to annual limit
briefDescription: General practitioner visits and basic outpatient services at Tier 1 network hospitals.
detailedDescription: Covers consultation fees, basic examination, and routine outpatient care at in-network Tier 1 facilities. Subject to the plan annual limit of ₦200,000. Requires 3 months continuous stay (T3) before eligibility.

briefDescription: Emergency stabilization and accident-related acute care.
detailedDescription: Immediate emergency and accident care at network hospitals. No waiting period (T0). Sub-limit ₦30,000 per policy year for eligible emergency events.

briefDescription: Minor and selected surgical procedures in-network.
detailedDescription: Eligible surgical procedures after 6 months continuous cover (T6), starting at ₦50,000 sub-limit. After 9 months (T9), surgical sub-limit increases to ₦100,000.

briefDescription: Management of major illnesses within plan sub-limit.
detailedDescription: Coverage for major disease management after T6 waiting period, up to ₦50,000 sub-limit within the annual pool.

effectiveRuleSubtitle: Effective after 6 months · chronic conditions only
briefDescription: Ongoing chronic disease monitoring and medication support.
detailedDescription: Chronic disease management benefit after 6 months continuous stay. Sub-limit ₦30,000 per policy year.

briefDescription: Basic dental procedures at network providers.
detailedDescription: Dental care including extractions and basic restorative work after T6, up to ₦10,000 sub-limit.

effectiveRuleSubtitle: Telemedicine T0 · other items per schedule
detailedDescription: Includes 24/7 tele-consultation (T0) and other supplementary benefits as defined in the product brochure.
Comprehensive outpatient cover after T3 within ₦500,000 annual limit.
Emergency benefit up to ₦50,000, effective from day one.
Outpatient services within Hygeia network after T3.
Entry-level outpatient benefit after T3 waiting period.
Personal accident death benefit up to ₦2,250,000, no medical waiting period.
